methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: AI Ready Roanoke represents a deliberate regional capacity-building effort outside NoVA, suggesting distributed AI fluency may emerge through intentional local convening rather than platform adoption or market concentration alone.

signals.title: Warner, Anthropic launch AI pilot to help Hampton Roads military families find local resources - The Legacy Newspaper
signals.signal_reading: Senator Warner partnering with Anthropic to deploy an AI pilot for military families indicates platform-delivered AI solutions reaching non-tech communities, but raises questions about whether shallow tool use creates genuine capability or just vendor dependency.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon canceling data center expansion due to local backlash suggests infrastructure concentration without community buy-in creates resistance rather than distributed AI capability, potentially stalling even concentrated development.

signals.title: Norfolk Public Library to teach people about AI - KCAU 9 News
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk Public Library teaching AI literacy represents grassroots education infrastructure in a non-metro tech hub, signaling potential for peer-network-driven fluency distribution if sustained beyond one-off workshops.

signals.title: Virginia governor orders statewide plan to address AI cyberattacks - StateScoop
signals.signal_reading: Governor's executive order on AI cybersecurity indicates state-level recognition of AI risk, but top-down mandates without regional capacity-building mechanisms may deepen the gap between prepared metros and under-resourced localities.
